question: Whose autobiography is titled 'The Substance and the Shadow'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dilip Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Substance and the Shadow** is the autobiography of **Dilip Kumar**.
 
• It was released in **2014 **at an event in Mumbai. 
 
• The book is a first-person account of the 91-year-old Dileep Kumar’s ups and downs in his much-talked-about relationships, marriage, and movies.
 
• His real name was Mohammed Yusuf Khan.
 
• Referred to as the **"Tragedy King" **for his portrayal of serious roles and retrospectively as "The First Khan" of Bollywood, he has been described as one of the most successful film stars in the industry and is credited with bringing a distinct form of method acting to the cinema.
 
• Kumar holds the record for **most wins for the Filmfare Award for Best Actor** (eight, which was later equalled by Shah Rukh Khan) and was also the inaugural recipient of the award, he has won** 3 Filmfare awards** consecutively (which was later equalled by Abhishek Bachchan).
